default_policy.review_rule: Only the governed release script may contact the configured GitHub origin and public GitHub Releases API.

scripts/release_skill.py.purpose: Atomically push the skill main branch and SemVer tag, then verify the GitHub Release created for that tag.
scripts/release_skill.py.custom_url_policy: origin must match a github.com HTTPS or SSH repository; arbitrary hosts are rejected
scripts/release_skill.py.auth: existing Git credential for push; GitHub Release readback is public
